mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, main_id, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, warehouse_area, warehouse_location, sku_id, sku_no, org_id, org_name
mapper.select: SELECT spd.id, spd.main_id, spd.warehouse_id, spd.warehouse_name, spd.warehouse_area, spd.warehouse_location, spd.sku_id, spd.sku_no, spd.org_id, spd.org_name, dbt."name" as warehouseTypeName, pdt."name" as productName, SUM(CASE WHEN inv.dict_inventory_status ='usable' THEN inv.qty ELSE 0 END) as usableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN inv.dict_inventory_status ='frozen' THEN inv.qty ELSE 0 END) as frozenQty from stocktaking_plan_detail as spd LEFT JOIN warehouse wt on wt.id = spd.warehouse_id and wt.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN dict_basic dbt on wt.type_id = dbt.id and dbt.is_deleted =false LEFT JOIN product_detail pdt on pdt.id = spd.sku_id and pdt.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN inventory inv on inv.org_id = spd.org_id and inv.warehouse_id = spd.warehouse_id and inv.warehouse_location = spd.warehouse_area and inv.sku_id = spd.sku_id where spd.is_deleted = false GROUP BY spd.id,spd.main_id,spd.warehouse_id,spd.warehouse_name,spd.warehouse_area,spd.warehouse_location,spd.sku_id,spd.sku_no,spd.org_id,spd.org_name,warehouseTypeName, productName
